tool_signatures.name: filter (string, default "saved")
tool_signatures.description: Filter saved items: "saved" (active/in-progress), "completed" (marked done), "archived".

tool_signatures.name: filter_date_after (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Filter messages sent after a specific date in format YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2023-10-01, July, Yesterday or Today. If not provided, all dates will be searched.

tool_signatures.name: filter_date_before (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Filter messages sent before a specific date in format YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2023-10-01, July, Yesterday or Today. If not provided, all dates will be searched.

tool_signatures.name: filter_date_during (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Filter messages sent during a specific period in format YYYY-MM-DD. Example: July, Yesterday or Today. If not provided, all dates will be searched.

tool_signatures.name: filter_date_on (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Filter messages sent on a specific date in format YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2023-10-01, July, Yesterday or Today. If not provided, all dates will be searched.

tool_signatures.name: filter_in_channel (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Filter messages in a specific channel by its ID or name. Example: C1234567890 or #general. If not provided, all channels will be searched.

tool_signatures.name: filter_in_im_or_mpim (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Filter messages in a direct message (DM) or multi-person direct message (MPIM) conversation by its ID or name. Example: D1234567890 or @username_dm. If not provided, all DMs and MPIMs will be searched.

tool_signatures.name: filter_threads_only (boolean, default
tool_signatures.description: false): If true, the response will include only messages from threads. Default is boolean false.

tool_signatures.name: filter_users_from (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Filter messages from a specific user by their ID or display name. Example: U1234567890 or @username. If not provided, all users will be searched.

tool_signatures.name: filter_users_with (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Filter messages with a specific user by their ID or display name in threads and DMs. Example: U1234567890 or @username. If not provided, all threads and DMs will be searched.

tool_signatures.name: handle (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Mention handle without @ (e.g., "engineering"). If not provided, Slack will auto-generate one.

tool_signatures.name: handle (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: New mention handle.

tool_signatures.name: include_activity_messages (boolean, default
tool_signatures.description: false): If true, the response will include activity messages such as channel_join or channel_leave. Default is boolean false.

tool_signatures.name: include_activity_messages (boolean, default
tool_signatures.description: false): If true, the response will include activity messages such as 'channel_join' or 'channel_leave'. Default is boolean false.

tool_signatures.name: include_count (boolean, default
tool_signatures.description: true): Include user count for each group.

tool_signatures.name: include_disabled (boolean, default
tool_signatures.description: false): Include disabled/archived groups.

tool_signatures.name: include_messages (boolean, default
tool_signatures.description: true): If true, returns the actual unread messages. If false, returns only a summary of channels with unreads.

tool_signatures.name: include_messages (boolean, default true)
tool_signatures.description: If true, fetches the actual saved message content. If false, returns metadata only.

tool_signatures.name: include_users (boolean, default
tool_signatures.description: false): Include list of user IDs in each group.

tool_signatures.name: limit (number, default

tool_signatures.name: limit (string, default
tool_signatures.description: "1d"): Limit of messages to fetch in format of maximum ranges of time (e.g. 1d - 1 day, 1w - 1 week, 30d - 30 days, 90d - 90 days which is a default limit for free tier history) or number of messages (e.g. 50). Must be empty when 'cursor' is provided.

tool_signatures.name: limit (string, default
tool_signatures.description: "1d"): Limit of messages to fetch in format of maximum ranges of time (e.g. 1d - 1 day, 1w - 1 week, 30d - 30 days, 90d - 90 days which is a default limit for free tier history) or number of messages (e.g. 50). Must be empty when 'cursor' is provided.

tool_signatures.name: mark (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Set to "completed" to mark the item as done.

tool_signatures.name: max_channels (number, default
tool_signatures.description: 50): Maximum number of channels to fetch unreads from.

tool_signatures.name: max_messages_per_channel (number, default
tool_signatures.description: 10): Maximum messages to fetch per channel.

tool_signatures.name: max_messages_per_item (number, default 5)
tool_signatures.description: Max messages to fetch per saved item (for thread replies).

tool_signatures.name: mentions_only (boolean, default
tool_signatures.description: false): If true, only returns channels where you have @mentions. Note: This filter only works with browser tokens; OAuth tokens will return all unread channels.

tool_signatures.name: name (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: New name for the group.

tool_signatures.name: name (string, required)
tool_signatures.description: Name of the user group (e.g., "Engineering Team").

tool_signatures.name: payload (string, required)
tool_signatures.description: Message payload in specified content_type format. Example: 'Hello, world!' for text/plain or '# Hello, world!' for text/markdown.

tool_signatures.name: query (string, required)
tool_signatures.description: Search query - matches against real name, display name, username, or email.

tool_signatures.name: search_query (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Search query to filter messages. Example: 'marketing report' or full URL of Slack message e.g. 'https://slack.com/archives/C1234567890/p1234567890123456', then the tool will return a single message matching given URL, herewith all other parameters will be ignored.

tool_signatures.name: sort (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Type of sorting. Allowed values: popularity - sort by number of members/participants in each channel.

tool_signatures.name: thread_ts (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Unique identifier of either a thread’s parent message or a message in the thread_ts must be the timestamp in format 1234567890.123456 of an existing message with 0 or more replies. Optional, if not provided the message will be added to the channel itself, otherwise it will be added to the thread.

tool_signatures.name: thread_ts (string, required)
tool_signatures.description: Unique identifier of either a thread’s parent message or a message in the thread. ts must be the timestamp in format 1234567890.123456 of an existing message with 0 or more replies.

tool_signatures.name: timestamp (string, required)
tool_signatures.description: Timestamp of the message to add reaction to, in format 1234567890.123456.

tool_signatures.name: timestamp (string, required)
tool_signatures.description: Timestamp of the message to remove reaction from, in format 1234567890.123456.

tool_signatures.name: ts (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Timestamp of the message to mark as read up to. If not provided, marks all messages as read.

tool_signatures.name: ts (string, required)
tool_signatures.description: Message timestamp of the saved item (from saved_list output).
